system: ASTRACARE AI - Automated Kaggle ML Pipeline

domains.name: PCOS Risk & Hormonal Diagnosis
domains.provenance: 10 hospital cohorts / Kottayam Medical Centre clinical data (541 records)
domains.rationale: High feature relevance to non-invasive questionnaire and physiological metrics. Target clearly defined with clean binary indicator.

domains.name: Menstrual Cycle Duration & Variability
domains.provenance: Aggregated mobile cycle logs and basal body temperature cohorts (>12,000 cycle events)
domains.rationale: Longitudinal tracking records providing clean continuous target for cycle duration prediction with wearable and lifestyle features.

domains.name: Anemia & Iron Deficiency Screener
domains.provenance: Clinical laboratory screening and associated symptom checklist (>1,400 records)
domains.rationale: Directly maps multi-symptom female check-in data with iron status screening classification.

domains.name: Cardiometabolic & Diabetes Risk
domains.provenance: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (all female cohort aged >= 21)
domains.rationale: Gold-standard all-female metabolic cohort with clean clinical markers and high predictive benchmark reliability.

domains.name: Thyroid Disorder (Hypo / Hyperthyroid) Risk
domains.provenance: Garavan Institute Thyroid Cohort with female-dominant endocrinological symptoms (>3,700 records)
domains.rationale: Distinct clinical presentation separating Hypothyroid (weight gain, bradycardia, heavy cycles) vs Hyperthyroid (tachycardia, heat intolerance, light cycles).

summary: All 5 candidate domains have undergone rigorous provenance, license, class-balance, and medical safety evaluation. All 5 are verified for production pipeline integration.
